title: Fallen Angel in Gothic Ruin
description: A decayed angelic figure with one large feathered wing and one skeletal wing stands screaming in the center. Green spectral flames pour from her open mouth while a black skeletal horse formed of smoke and fire emerges beside her. The background features a large broken gothic cathedral window with clover designs, floating bubbles containing miniature scenes, roses, and dripping organic matter.
prompt: A decayed female angel with one white feathered wing and one skeletal wing, her face melting and screaming as bright green spectral flames pour from her mouth. A black skeletal horse made of green fire and smoke emerges from her side. She stands in front of a massive broken gothic cathedral rose window with clover motifs. Floating transparent bubbles contain miniature scenes including a castle and a bird. Dark roses, vines, and dripping white liquid surround the scene in a highly detailed dark fantasy style.
